servers.name: FreeGameStore
servers.description: AI agent tools for the FreeGameStore platform. Build, publish, and improve PWA games end-to-end from your editor: scaffold and deploy a new game, write files and auto-redeploy, or hand a prompt to the VibeCode agent — plus inspect games, check deploys, and fetch SDK/platform reference.

tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Create + publish a new game: provision repo/hosting/listing, scaffold a template (canvas/grid/cards/3d), deploy live at <id>.freegamestore.online

tools.name: update_files
tools.description: Write/overwrite files in a game you own; auto-redeploys

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from a game's repo

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files in a game's repo

tools.name: agent_build
tools.description: Hand a prompt to the VibeCode agent; it writes the code and deploys it (bring-your-own AI key)

tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Poll an agent_build session for game id, deploy phase, live URL

tools.name: game_info
tools.description: Get a game's live URL, repo, store listing, status

tools.name: deploy_status
tools.description: Check recent GitHub Actions deploy runs for a game

tools.name: game_logs
tools.description: Latest deploy/build logs for a game

tools.name: platform_guide
tools.description: Fetch the full SKILLS.md platform guide
